replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Might want to give this a read: http://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/music/news/chester-bennington-dead-death-depression-....

On top of that, he was sexually abused as a child, took drugs, was an alcoholic, his best friend died a little more than a month beforehand and his so-called 'fans' insulted him over his new album, one which he described as the band's most personal one to date. In short, he was unbelievably strong to live as long as he did. ='(
